Subject: Marquette Plumbing Services - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the submission on Marquette Plumbing Services. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need from a documentation standpoint.

However, this risk requires referral to senior underwriting for two reasons:
- Contractor class requires additional approval
- The $5.2M total insured value exceeds our standard authority limit for this class

I'll escalate this internally and circle back within 2-3 business days. In the meantime, given the size and class, you may also want to consider reaching out to a specialty contractor market, one that typically has broader appetite for larger contracting risks.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best,
[Underwriter name]
